title: Native renderer safe packed matrix staging
scope: Two localhost Chromium processes sharing one host. 960x720 picture; every forward frame/effect retained. Dirty replica is diagnostic. CPU sampling is not GPU timing; captured frames are not physical scanout or input-to-photon.

experimentNotes.a1: Current harness, original matrix path with packedstate=0, immediate reuse off
experimentNotes.b1: Retained packed matrices only, immediate reuse off
experimentNotes.a2: Return to original matrix path with packedstate=0, immediate reuse off
experimentNotes.harness: Fresh safe-config A/B/A and CPU profiles; strict per-frame full RGBA/camera audits are separate untimed correctness runs.

rejectedExperiment.description: Combined packed matrix and immediate GPU-plan reuse failed the strict per-frame Link/Kirby oracle at frame 98. No omitted field or root cause has been established; later passing isolation runs do not resolve it. Immediate reuse remains explicitly opt-in.
